meta.method: Home (RES) systems installed 2021-01-01 to 2025-02-28, excluding self-installs and records without a company name. ZIP codes are placed in counties with ClearEV's Census ZIP file. Counties list up to 8 companies with at least 3 systems; states list the top 10. Medians use only systems where the file states the value; price per watt uses home-owned (not leased or PPA) systems, before incentives, and needs at least 5 of them.
